* '''PC-E1''' ([[Swarming Vulture Droid (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”; file created 13 October 2026).
